item.title: Schools in Balwyn Melbourne 2026: State, Private and School Zones
item.description:
Schools in Balwyn: What Families Need to Know

Moving to Balwyn with school-age children? Schools are the second thing you research after rent. In Melbourne, school zones drive real estate decisions as much as train lines and cafe strips. Understanding Balwyn’s school landscape before you sign a lease saves you from the most common mistake: assuming access to a school your address does not zone you into.

State Primary Schools

Balwyn is served by government primary schools within its zone boundaries. Enrolment is based on your residential address falling within the school’s designated neighbourhood boundary. You have a right to enrol at your designated neighbourhood school.
